figurative_meaning_en: Enhancement of beauty through cosmetics or makeup
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে প্রতিদিন ঘষামাজা করে বাইরে যায়।
ঘষামাজা ছাড়া তার সৌন্দর্য অসম্পূর্ণ লাগে।
example_sentences_in_english: She goes out every day after her makeup routine.
Her beauty feels incomplete without some cosmetic enhancement.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali practices of using natural or simple cosmetics for beauty enhancement, often in everyday or rural contexts.
